lead: Brigitte Macron is best known as a French secondary school teacher, born on 13 April 1953 in Amiens.
As of 2026, she is 73 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aries sign.

She has held the office of spouse of the President of France and has been recognised with Grand Cross of the Order of the Dannebrog and Knight Grand Cross of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic.
Below you will find a verified overview of Brigitte Macron: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Brigitte Macron — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Brigitte Macron was born on 13 April 1953 in Amiens, and holds French nationality. She was given the name Brigitte Marie-Claude Trogneux at birth and is publicly known as Brigitte Macron.
Public records name her father, Jean Trogneux and her mother, Simone Pujol. She is a sibling of Jean-Claude Trogneux.
Her listed education includes Lycée Henri-IV.
She is recorded as speaking French.

sections.heading: Brigitte Macron — Career and Professional Work
paras: Brigitte Macron works primarily as a secondary school teacher, with Lycée Saint-Louis-de-Gonzague listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: spouse of the President of France (2017–present).
